Pancakes

breakfast

Ingredients

Dry

  • 1 1/2 cup (180g) AP flour
  • 1 Tbsp baking
  • 1 Tbsp white sugar
  • 1/4 tsp salt
  • sprinkle of cinnamon

Wet

  • 1 cup milk
  • 3 Tbsp oil
  • 1 egg
  • 1 tsp vanilla

Procedure

  1. combine dry
  2. combine wet
  3. pour wet onto dry and mix - leave lumpy
  4. 1/4 cup doses onto hot griddle
